summary: Your Pro licence can now arrive and renew by itself.

new.title: Licence arrives by itself (optional)
new.text: When no Pro licence is installed or yours ends within 30 days, PIM Manager can request and install it from Invardia. Switch it on under Settings > Features.

fixes.title: Licence page wording corrected
fixes.text: The Licence page no longer calls a licence without a tenant valid for any tenant.
